name: South Carolina

fees.note: Single trip permit $30 (one permit covers size and weight).
'Excessive width' rates $35 (>16'), $40 (>18'), $45 (>20'), $50 (>22'). Modeled as replacing the $30 rate (group) - verify whether SCDOT charges it in addition to the $30.
Superload impact fee $3.00 per 1,000 lb for loads over 130,000 lb. Statute does not say whether it is on total gross or on weight above 130,000 lb (e.g. 150,000 lb: $450 vs $60) - verify with SCDOT.
Megaload impact fee $0.05 per 1,000 lb per mile on the entire gross weight (= $0.10 per ton-mile).

escorts.when: Over 12' wide, on two-lane and other roads

police.text: 2 police escorts. Over 16' wide: one front and one rear police escort (in addition to two civilian escorts) unless the Permit Director approves otherwise in writing; escorting officers may require more. Request via SC DPS State Transport Police.

restrictions.text: Sunrise to sunset only, Monday-Sunday. No travel on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Fourth of July, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas; the Permit Director may also restrict noon the day before to noon the day after.
Over 12' to 15' wide: no travel near large urban areas 7-9 AM every day, 3-6 PM on school days and 4:30-6 PM on non-school days.
Over 15' wide: travel only 9 AM-3 PM on school days and 9 AM-4 PM other days.

Over 14' wide: must use four-lane highways (two-lane only with 12'+ lanes where possible) and be the only vehicle on bridges 18' wide or less. Over 16' needs a separate over-16' application and route approval.

Memorial Day-Labor Day: no Saturday/Sunday movement east of I-95 in the Myrtle Beach area (US-378, SC-327, US-76, SC-576, US-501, SC-22, SC-31, SC-9, US-17 from NC line to Georgetown, and nearby routes). Convoys prohibited (2 miles apart).
Loads up to 130,000 lb gross with legal dimensions may get continuous (24-hour) travel on request; holiday bans still apply.

travel.note: No travel on the six holidays for any permit.
Continuous travel only up to 130,000 lb with legal dimensions; heavier loads sunrise to sunset.

closures: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun until 09:00: Before 9 AM
mon, tue, wed, thu, fri from 15:00 (months [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12]): After 3 PM on school days (school year approximated as Aug-May weekdays)
mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun from 16:00: After 4 PM on other days
travel.note: Over 15' wide: 9 AM-3 PM on school days, 9 AM-4 PM other days, Monday-Sunday.

sources.title: SCDOT Guidelines for Movement of OSOW Vehicles and Loads (Rev. 8/2021)
SC Code Title 56 Chapter 5 (56-5-4030 width, 56-5-4060 height, 56-5-4070 length, 56-5-4140 gross weight)

notes: Routine permit maximums: 16' wide, 125' long; beyond needs Permit Director approval. Height must clear structures by 3 in.; utilities must be arranged at least 3 working days ahead.
Superload also triggered by any single axle over 20,000 lb (not modeled); takes 3-5 business days. Loads over 300,000 lb may need an independent structural analysis by a licensed engineer.
Fee schedule last revised July 1, 2012 per SCDOT; $5 credit-card convenience fee not included.
Department may require a rear escort for 12'-14' loads on multi-lane roads at its discretion.
